summary: session-context.js lacked the require.main===module stdin guard that status.js and dispatch-ledger.js already carry, so requiring it in-process (as this task needed to test main()) risked a second uncontrolled main() call ending in process.exit(0) mid-test-run; fixed as part of this task since the objective required calling main() from Jest
evidence: reproduced the hang/kill by requiring the un-guarded file and letting stdin reach end mid-Jest-run (same failure documented at status.js:376-387); fixed by adding the same require.main === module guard
